canonicalPhases.description: TDD evidence is an embedded development gate; new work uses development PRE_IMPLEMENTATION / POST_IMPLEMENTATION gates.

auxiliaryActions.description: Generate, serially Review, revise, and freeze concrete development tasks for a large requirement without creating a new lifecycle phase.
Generate read-only HTML copies from Markdown facts without changing lifecycle state.
Merge confirmed version increments into project-level full facts without Git/Release/deployment actions.
In lightweight mode, finalize requirement/design completeness from the current session, existing documents, and implementation code, then archive the confirmed facts.
Create a local, sequential Git phase checkpoint after the current gate passes; never push, merge, release, or deploy.

currentAgent.positionRule: current Agent selector may appear anywhere accepted by the concrete CLI; conceptual $Common-develop syntax places it before target selectors -f/-b

modelCode.description: Only when enabled are frontend and backend pseudocode required.

pageDesign.description: Only when enabled is page business behavior and interaction design included; visual design remains excluded.

minimal.description: Skip test_design/testing and suppress Development TDD verification; require non-test evidence.
minimal.skipReason: 当前版本使用 wk -min，按已声明范围跳过全部测试阶段。

lightweight.description: Conversational pair-programming mode. Confirm requirement, design, and implementation incrementally; lightweight mode always skips TDD, test-design, review, test-code, test-case, and test execution artifacts.
lightweight.skipReason: 当前版本使用 wk -ws：采用对话式结对开发；轻量模式强制跳过 TDD、测试设计、Review、测试代码、测试用例和测试执行，不允许在模式保持开启时恢复。

auto.description: Automatically continue through the Skill workflow without user confirmation; when CI/P0/P1/authority-stale/safety-block stops batch-forward, enter the machine-governed remediation loop and resume only after the current gate is clean.

gitCheckpoint.description: Create one local Git checkpoint commit after each passed phase gate; sequential single-repository mode only.

gitPush.description: Push each successful -gc checkpoint; native Git first, GitHub Connector fallback only for github.com network/auth transport failure. Phase advance requires remote verification.

architectureReview.description: Split development into a reviewed architecture-code skeleton iteration and a concrete implementation iteration.

reviewOnly.description: Machine-enforced review-only mutation boundary: task facts and project documentation may change; tests, configuration, and production code may not change.

applicationPolicy.description: Applying or initializing a work mode synchronizes existing task runtimes unless explicitly disabled.

taskPlanning.description: For large requirements, generate, review, and revise a task plan before implementation_plan passes.

reviewPolicy.onFinding: stop remaining Review, set the plan to REWORK, modify task content, create a new TP revision, and restart Review from the first required Reviewer

requestIntake.descriptionInputPolicy: wk -b descriptions are BUG; wk -f descriptions require explicit project-fact classification.
requestIntake.listCommandPolicy: wk -l -b/-f accept resolved IDs only and never create or classify requests.

bug.description: Select an existing BUG ID or classify the full text as a BUG request.

feature.description: Select an existing FEATURE ID or classify the text as a new requirement, requirement change, simple optimization, or needs-confirmation request.

start.description: Classify and preview or initialize one request transactionally.

status.description: Show the current task, request, gate, and validation status.

doctor.description: Inspect project health and optionally preview or apply registered idempotent safe repairs.

next.description: Return the next legal command, required Agent, and reason codes.

context.description: Show reducer-derived current task context without treating cache projections as authority.

help.description: Discover wk flags and commands from the Runtime Contract without loading it wholesale.

packs.description: Resolve capability packs while preserving one Skill authority.

reconcile.description: Explain lifecycle fact convergence and optionally apply deterministic process-only reconciliation.

close.description: Preview or apply the current phase closure using the existing fail-closed finalize gate.

document-archive.description: Finalize lightweight-mode knowledge archives; --apply consumes the completed plan and --audit-bundle exports revision-bound audit data.

env.description: Project the capabilities declared by project_env.md and harness_env.md without assuming a technology stack.

impact.description: Derive change impact and minimum safe revalidation; adapters may narrow scope but never bypass lifecycle gates.

delivery.description: Plan/evaluate generic capability-driven Delivery Readiness under completion_verification without creating a project-specific release phase.

confirm.description: Preview or apply a bounded batch authorization without bypassing lifecycle gates.

progress.description: ProjectManagerAgent previews or applies one existing phase action using the current planDigest.

finish.description: Validate in the task project root (parent of DOC_ROOT); --cwd selects an existing directory within that project.

independentDatabase.description: Run independent test-database tests only when all required environment groups resolve to non-empty values.
independentDatabase.missingReason: 独立测试库环境变量未完整设置，跳过独立测试库测试；不得回退到 local/dev/生产业务库。

executionPolicy.description: All targets and plan tasks execute sequentially. A, B, and C may be grouped by lifecycle stage, but only one target or task may be active at a time in the declared order.

referenceReader.policy: Resources with readStrategy=relevant_sections require explicit section or query selection; full reads require --full.

BUG_FLOW.description: BUG_ID and wk -b descriptions always use the bug workflow.

FEATURE_FLOW.description: Existing FEATURE_ID intake uses the standard lifecycle until project facts classify a narrower change.

SIMPLE_OPTIMIZATION_FLOW.description: Presentation-only optimization with no logic, data, contract, permission, workflow, persistence, side-effect, migration, or dependency changes.

preImplementation.rule: New behavior/BUG RED evidence must exist before the corresponding production mutation; pure refactor uses a GREEN baseline.

postImplementation.rule: GREEN/REFACTOR/spec compliance are verified on the frozen development revision.

excluded.scripts/delivery_readiness.py: shared implementation; public entrypoint is wk.delivery
excluded.scripts/domain_governance.py: internal domain-governance implementation; no public permission surface
excluded.scripts/engineering_graph.py: internal graph implementation; no public permission surface
